portable_goal: Install and run the AI-Scientist-style Web 2D game generation skill on another Codex machine with embedded map/sprite generation subfunctions, public benchmark bootstrap, graceful dependency degradation, and strict real-visual-asset gates.
embedded_subfunction_policy: External generate2dmap/generate2dsprite skills are preferred when installed, but the portable package embeds their SKILL.md references and processing scripts. Missing peer skills must not downgrade final art into procedural placeholders.
public_benchmark_bootstrap_policy: Each project must run scripts/bootstrap_public_benchmarks.py to create .game_scientist/benchmarks.json and benchmark_bootstrap_report.json before final benchmark iteration. The script auto-discovers VBench, T2I-CompBench, DoveNet/iHarmony repos, checkpoints, and wrapper commands via workspace layout or environment variables. If ready_public_runner_count is 0, final high-quality selection is blocked and the run is prototype/advisory only.
video_generation_policy: Volcengine Seedance and other video generation services are optional. If the user wants to open/login/authorize Volcengine, use it and record task id plus provenance. If no video generator is available, skip video generation and continue with a static background.
visual_asset_source_policy: Final high-quality games must use real generated or approved high-resolution image assets. Background, midground, platforms, gates, pickups, and hazards default to generate2dmap or equivalent image-generation workflows. Heroes, enemies, bosses, and FX default to generate2dsprite or equivalent sprite-generation workflows. Procedural SVG, Canvas, CSS, Phaser Graphics, geometry, noise, and debug rectangles are prototype/debug only and must fail final visual_asset_source_gate.
fallback_policy: Missing external generators or public benchmark runners must be reported as disabled or SKIPPED_NO_SCORE; do not fabricate official scores, task ids, videos, provenance, or high-quality final status. If real asset generation or approved high-resolution assets are unavailable, only a design plan, scaffold, or clearly marked prototype may be delivered.
